title: Player statistics
description:
Using the `Player` struct provided, write three functions. Each one is a single standard algorithm plus a lambda.

| Function | Use |
|---|---|
| `void sortByScore(std::vector<Player>& players)` highest score first; equal scores by name A to Z | `std::sort` |
| `std::vector<Player> scoringAtLeast(const std::vector<Player>& players, int minimum)` a new vector, original order kept | `std::copy_if` with `std::back_inserter` |
| `int totalScore(const std::vector<Player>& players)` | `std::accumulate` (in `<numeric>`) |
hints: `std::accumulate(first, last, 0, [](int sum, const Player& p) { return sum + p.score; })` starts at 0 and folds each player into the running sum.
